metadata.title: Is JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA Actually Worth It in 2026? (Good vs Bad)

google_flow_prompts.lighting_environment: Cyberpunk Cyan & Blue LED backlight, subtle dark ambient contrast
google_flow_prompts.camera_framing: Vertical 9:16 macro closeups, smooth panning across developer monitor and keyboard
google_flow_prompts.rendering_quality: 4K 60fps photorealistic UI demonstration with neon light reflections

shots.visual_description: Cinematic fast zoom into a glowing ultra-wide monitor displaying JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA. Code lines populate smoothly with real-time syntax highlighting.
shots.voiceover_script: Looking for your next primary code editor? Today on IDE Guide, we review JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA by JetBrains.
shots.b_roll: Close-up macro shot of mechanical keyboard keypresses and IDE splash screen.

shots.visual_description: Split-screen glowing highlight showing key features and top positive pros with green checkmark graphics floating in 3D.
shots.voiceover_script: Here is what makes it great: Industry-best Java/Kotlin code analysis and refactoring engines. Plus, Comprehensive database tooling, Spring framework support, and debugger.
shots.b_roll: Screen recording demonstrating quick code auto-completion and key editor shortcuts.

shots.visual_description: Overlay shifts to dark red accents with subtle animated warning badge icons highlighting limitations.
shots.voiceover_script: However, keep these drawbacks in mind: High memory footprint; requires 8GB+ RAM for smooth performance
shots.b_roll: CPU/RAM resource monitor gauge overlay showing memory footprint.

shots.visual_description: Comparison matrix UI showing free vs paid tier badges and target audience profiles.
shots.voiceover_script: Pricing model: Free Community Edition / $169-$599/yr Ultimate Edition. It is best suited for Enterprise Java/Kotlin engineers, backend developers, and Spring Boot specialists.
shots.b_roll: Clean pricing card graphic and developer avatar icon.

shots.visual_description: Outro card displaying IDE Guide logo, YouTube subscribe prompt (@IDEguide), and text disclaimer banner.
shots.voiceover_script: Subscribe to IDE Guide for daily objective editor breakdowns! Full non-sponsorship disclaimer in description.
shots.b_roll: Animated Subscribe button click and URL callout to ideguide.blogspot.com.
